title: The Borgers Impedance resolves the neutron lifetime gap and the Hubble tension

statements.text: Projection from the 9D source costs a geometric tax, the Borgers Impedance $Z_g = \alpha \sqrt{2}$. As a correction factor it accounts for the neutron lifetime anomaly as geometry rather than decay, and nine times it, $Z_H = 9 Z_g$, quantifies the Hubble tension.

sources.quote: We derive the Borgers Impedance constant, {Z}_g = alpha \sqrt{2}, and prove its dual-scale validity
A geometric resonance factor, γ = √2, is derived from the topological features of the confining geometry in bottle experiments.
